name: grow-and-learn
description: Grow and Learn daycare and preschool website

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true}); fs.mkdirSync('dist', {recursive: true}); ['index.html', 'styles.css', 'script.js'].forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync('src/' + f, 'dist/' + f)); console.log('Build completed successfully.');"
